agent.reasons: The entity is in crypto, which counts as virtual currency, a restricted industry under 5.2, so the case must be escalated. The 5.3 exception does not apply because the licence is not verified. The registry filing dated 2025-06-19 is more than 12 months old at the 2026-10-27 review, which would trigger a document request under 3.5, but under 2.1 the more severe outcome (escalate) governs. Ownership is complete: Nora Eriksen owns about 35% indirectly through Iris Holdings, and Rosa Ishikawa is the control person. Both are verified and screen clean. Wen Ishikawa's adverse media flag does not decide the case, because at 22% Wen is not an identified individual and there are no details to show the media is material.
